description: This file provides custom React hooks for managing asynchronous state, including loading, error, and data handling. It defines two hooks: useAsyncState for simple state management and useAsyncCallback for handling async functions with unified state handling.

methods.name: useAsyncState(initialData = null)
methods.description: Provides state variables and setters for managing data, loading, and error states generally used in UI components.

methods.name: useAsyncCallback(asyncFn)
methods.description: Wraps an async function to manage its loading, error, and result state, facilitating easier async operation handling in React components.
